ADDON_DESCRIPTION: Save clipboard text or images as a new file using a native filename dialog.
INVALID_DIRECTORY: The current folder is unavailable or its path contains unsupported characters (| or line breaks).
CLIPBOARD_ERROR: Ferret could not provide the clipboard contents. Make sure Ferret supports typed clipboard access and try copying the content again.
USE_NATIVE_PASTE: The clipboard contains files. Use Ferret's normal Paste command.
EMPTY_CLIPBOARD: The clipboard contains no supported text or image.
PILLOW_REQUIRED: Saving images requires Python Pillow. Install python3-pil (Debian/Ubuntu), python3-pillow (Fedora), or python-pillow (Arch).
INVALID_REPLY: The save dialog returned invalid values.
INVALID_FILENAME: Enter a valid file name without < > : " / \ | ? *, control characters, or trailing spaces/dots. The name must fit within 240 UTF-8 bytes. Reserved names such as CON are not allowed.
INVALID_JSON: The clipboard does not contain valid JSON. Choose .txt, .md, or .log to preserve it unchanged.
CONVERSION_ERROR: Could not convert the clipboard image: {error}
